# Translexi Studio

> AI video production & webtoon localization house

Production house of Translexi (PT Solusi Bahasa Internasional), Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

## Pages

- [Translexi Studio — AI Video Production & Webtoon Localization](https://studio.translexi.com/): A production house under Translexi: AI video production for brands — ads, monthly social content — and webtoon localization done by humans.
- [Services — AI Video & Webtoon Localization | Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/): Everything Translexi Studio does: AI video production (ads, social content, strategy, subtitles) and webtoon localization (translation, cleanup, lettering).
- [AI Video Production Services for Brands — Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/ai-video/): AI video production services: ads and brand video, monthly social content, strategy built on your account data, subtitles & voice-over.
- [Webtoon Localization Services for Publishers — Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/webtoon-localization/): Webtoon & comic localization: translation, cleanup & redraw, typesetting, lettering. 1,500+ jobs since 2019 — same publisher, seven years running.
- [About Translexi Studio — Part of Translexi](https://studio.translexi.com/about/): Translexi Studio is the production house of PT Solusi Bahasa Internasional — a language house since 2009, now producing AI video and localizing webtoons.
- [Contact Translexi Studio — Send a Brief or a Webtoon Episode](https://studio.translexi.com/contact/): Reach Translexi Studio in Yogyakarta. Send a video brief or one webtoon episode — we reply with direction and an estimate, not a brochure.
